node.title: Re^4: Count the sequence length of each entry in the file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If on windows also delete "\r" characters.

This is not necessary as the [doc://PerlIO] :crlf layer is default on Windows and converts CRLF to LF on input. One can disable the translation with [doc://binmode] or the :raw pseudolayer, but that's not the case in any of the code shown here. See also [doc://perlport#Newlines|Newlines in perlport], and note that [doc://chomp] also handles paragraph mode correctly.
